title: Health Ministry contracts dashboard
human_request: Create a multi-table dataset for plotting Health Ministry contract activity.
notes: This spec intentionally contains multiple named queries. Use --format json for graph formatters; TSV/CSV output flattens all rows and adds result_name.

queries.name: active_health_contracts_trend_2021_2025
queries.title: Health Ministry active contracts trend, 2021-2025
queries.notes: Counts and sums Health Ministry contracts active in each year.
queries.query: WITH years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)) SELECT years.year, COUNT(*) AS active_contracts, SUM(contracts_data.volume) AS total_volume, SUM(contracts_data.executed) AS total_executed FROM years JOIN contracts_data ON contracts_data.purchasing_ministry = 'משרד הבריאות' AND contracts_data.start_year <= years.year AND COALESCE(contracts_data.end_year, 9999) >= years.year GROUP BY years.year ORDER BY years.year

queries.name: top_health_contracts_2025
queries.title: Top Health Ministry contracts active in 2025
queries.notes: Ranks active 2025 contracts by total approved contract volume.
queries.query: SELECT purpose, supplier_entity_name, purchasing_method, start_year, end_year, volume, executed, item_url FROM contracts_data WHERE purchasing_ministry = 'משרד הבריאות' AND start_year <= 2025 AND COALESCE(end_year, 9999) >= 2025 ORDER BY volume DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

queries.name: health_contracts_by_method_2025
queries.title: Health Ministry active contract volume by purchasing method in 2025
queries.notes: Ranks purchasing methods by total approved contract volume for contracts active in 2025.
queries.query: SELECT purchasing_method, COUNT(*) AS contract_count, SUM(volume) AS total_volume, SUM(executed) AS total_executed FROM contracts_data WHERE purchasing_ministry = 'משרד הבריאות' AND start_year <= 2025 AND COALESCE(end_year, 9999) >= 2025 GROUP BY purchasing_method ORDER BY total_volume DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

queries.name: top_health_suppliers_2025
queries.title: Top Health Ministry suppliers active in 2025
queries.notes: Groups active 2025 contracts by supplier and ranks by total approved contract volume.
queries.query: SELECT supplier_entity_name, supplier_entity_id, supplier_entity_kind, COUNT(*) AS contract_count, SUM(volume) AS total_volume, SUM(executed) AS total_executed FROM contracts_data WHERE purchasing_ministry = 'משרד הבריאות' AND start_year <= 2025 AND COALESCE(end_year, 9999) >= 2025 GROUP BY supplier_entity_name, supplier_entity_id, supplier_entity_kind ORDER BY total_volume DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
